title: Obstacle Course Builder
shareTitle: Obstacle Course Builder — Build It, Then Play It
description: Design a Papercraft obstacle course in the Backyard, Jungle, or Arctic, then help an animal guide crawl, climb, hop, carry, and belly-slide through the exact route you built.
learningGoals: Plan a three-to-five-step sequence and preserve its order
Explore how spatial placement changes a route's shape
Practice crawl, climb, hop, balance, carry, and steering gestures
Revise a design by moving, swapping, recoloring, undoing, and removing pieces
interactionModel: drag a reusable obstacle from the tray to a large board cell, or tap the obstacle then the glowing cell; move and swap placed pieces, recolor them, then use obstacle-specific direct gestures to play the authored course
feedbackModel: layered Papercraft movement, numbered route ribbons, pose-specific animal guides, verified recorded narration, gentle tactile SFX, one-shot hints, and an unscored three-star finish

modes.title: Backyard
modes.skill: spatial planning with crawl, climb, hop, and carry modules

modes.title: Jungle
modes.skill: route revision with crawl, climb, balance, and carry modules

modes.title: Arctic
modes.skill: curved route planning with combinable belly-slide ramps
